product_one_liner.value: ON3 Works is an AI-native technical recruitment agency that finds, vets and shortlists engineers, developers and IT specialists for companies hiring in the United Kingdom and Spain.
product_one_liner.notes: The official description directly identifies the recruitment service, the technical roles it fills and its UK and Spanish hiring customers. Source: https://on3works.com/about

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes the Agentic and Atelier recruitment offerings. Source: https://on3works.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: The notable-clients table and customer-testimonial area identify CGI, but no second customer was named in the reviewed customer material. Under the requested two-name threshold, the result is an empty list. Sources: https://on3works.com/about and https://on3works.com/

employee_band.notes: Bounce Watch reports 13 employees and the LinkedIn profile reports 14; both fall within 11–20. Directory counts may include associated recruiters or interviewers rather than only the two founders. Sources: https://bouncewatch.com/explore/startup/on3-works and https://linkedin.com/company/on3works

hq_location.notes: normalizer: partial location recorded as unknown (hq_city=null, hq_country="Spain") | hq_city: The official headquarters location is Mallorca, Spain. Mallorca is an island, and no headquarters city is specified; the founders’ individual locations are not sufficient to infer one. Source: https://on3works.com/about | hq_country: The current official About page identifies the headquarters as Mallorca, Spain, remote-first. This is preferred over older directory listings showing London. Source: https://on3works.com/about

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly says its founders started ON3 Works in 2022. Source: https://on3works.com/about

eng_blog.notes: The Insights index is hiring research for hiring managers and founders. It includes one AI-pipeline explanation among recruitment guides and comparisons, but not two qualifying engineering-authored how-built posts. Source: https://on3works.com/insights

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer link to recruitment resources, pricing, About and social profiles, but contain no product-documentation, help-center or developer-portal link. Source: https://on3works.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company-linked employment profile shows zero jobs, so no qualifying AI/ML opening is listed there. Confidence is limited because this is a third-party board, not an explicit company-wide hiring statement. Source: https://theorg.com/org/on3-works

model_provider.value: Google Gemini, OpenAI and Cohere, disclosed for ON3 Works’ Hiron platform.
model_provider.notes: ON3 identifies Hiron as its own sourcing infrastructure. Hiron’s privacy notice names Google Gemini and OpenAI for resume extraction and Cohere for matching embeddings. These disclosures concern Hiron; the separate fine-tuned vetting model is not named. Sources: https://on3works.com/ai-recruiting and https://hiron.ai/privacy

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: ON3 WORKS LTD’s Hiron privacy notice claims processing under UK GDPR legal bases and GDPR-compatible transfer safeguards. This supports a GDPR compliance claim, not independently certified status. The notice names none of the other four requested standards. Source: https://hiron.ai/privacy | compliance_certs.0: The ON3 WORKS LTD privacy notice describes processing under UK GDPR and permitted transfer safeguards; this is a compliance-framework claim rather than formal certification. Source: https://hiron.ai/privacy

Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/on3works/__Ui9HFPFE6DMuE-WnQEIl0MMFNagicD-LkN34xfSwduQ | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile states that ON3WORKS has not raised funding. With no funding round, an amount is not applicable and is left null rather than invented as zero. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/on3works/__Ui9HFPFE6DMuE-WnQEIl0MMFNagicD-LkN34xfSwduQ

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile states that the company has not raised any funding, supporting no funding raised during the preceding 18 months. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/on3works/__Ui9HFPFE6DMuE-WnQEIl0MMFNagicD-LkN34xfSwduQ

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The employment profile linked to on3works.com lists zero jobs, including no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening. Third-party board completeness remains a limitation. Source: https://theorg.com/org/on3-works

launched_6mo.notes: The readable Insights index and company-post history contained no qualifying product or major-feature launch in the six-month window. The latest visible dated post, 30 October 2026, concerns junior candidates rather than a launch. This negative is limited to the public history reviewed. Sources: https://on3works.com/insights and https://linkedin.com/company/on3works

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete, small team description identifies the two founders, established in 2022, plus an interviewing panel. It shows no newly appointed C-level or VP leader, and no qualifying departure was found. This is an absence-based conclusion rather than an explicit no-change announcement. Source: https://on3works.com/about

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The company’s own cookie disclosure explicitly says it uses Google Ads cookies to measure which ads generate enquiries. This is a marketing-system signal, not evidence of a particular CRM.
